title: S3 permission denied blocking file upload feature
symptoms: Logs: botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the PutObject operation. All user file uploads returning 403. S3 presigned URL generation working but actual uploads failing. Feature completely broken but no database impact.
root_cause: An IAM policy rotation removed the s3:PutObject permission from the application's IAM role. The IAM role ARN changed during a cloud infrastructure migration and the bucket policy still referenced the old ARN. Presigned URLs used a different credential path that was unaffected.
fix_applied: 1. Identified the issue: aws s3 cp test.txt s3://bucket/ — AccessDenied. 2. Updated IAM role policy to include s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:DeleteObject. 3. Updated bucket policy to reference new IAM role ARN. 4. Added IAM permission validation to deployment smoke tests. 5. Implemented AWS CloudTrail alerts for AccessDenied on production buckets.
